entities.name: UniProt Q72H00
observations: Exact full-sequence match: 249 aa, 27.44 kDa predicted mass, theoretical pI 5.47; annotated as phosphoserine phosphatase.
Catalyzes O-phospho-L-serine + H2O → L-serine + phosphate; annotated EC 3.1.3.3, with similar activity on O-phospho-D-serine.
Curated annotation reports Mg2+ or Co2+ as cofactors and a homodimeric state.
Pfam scans identify hydrolase (PF00702), HAD_2 (PF13419), and hydrolase-like (PF13242) regions; domains overlap.

entities.name: L-serine biosynthesis
observations: Q72H00 is annotated as catalyzing the terminal dephosphorylation step of phosphorylated L-serine biosynthesis.
